author: Nelev
body:
## Problem
Opening conversations from the sidebar could fail with a 429. Every `GET /conversations/{id}` shares one `10/minute` bucket per user, so clicking through a few conversations in a minute tripped it. The UI surfaced it as a generic error.

## Change
- `GET /` and `GET /conversations/{id}` now allow `60/minute;2000/day`. They only query Postgres.
- `/ask`, `/documents` and `/health/db` keep `10/minute;200/day`; the first two cost model calls.
- Rate-limit tests now check the tight limit and per-user buckets on `/ask`, plus a new test that 60 reads in a minute are allowed.
- README rate-limit paragraph updated.

## Testing
- `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `pytest`: 178 passed.
- Against a live server (auth and DB stubbed): 62 reads gave 60x200 then 2x429; 12 asks gave 10x201 then 2x429.

The counters are in process memory, so restart the API for the new limit to apply.
